There are better described as SWAT officers tasked to roam the street. They’re well trained, and are scarcely assigned to low-security areas. When something bad really goes down, a whole squad of these might show up before MAX-TAC arrives to steal the spotlight.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Ncpd).

description.value:
In less turbulent times, the name Ajax would more likely be associated with the Greek hero of legend, a European soccer club or a household cleaning product. For the residents of Night City, Ajax brings to mind only one thing: Militech's assault rifle. Its engineers made not an attempt to reinvent the wheel, but only to design a durable, reliable weapon that wouldn't require months of training or high-end combat cyberware to use it. Ultimately, the engineers' vision has been realized.

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Class: EQ Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Assault Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: NoSlots: 2 • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: None

Range: Assault Rifle
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

Cost: 100eb (Premium) ♦ Required Slots: 0

Fits: All Ranged Weapons

“How d’ya think it works? You take a flashlight, you know that metal stick that ain’t a sex aid, and bolt it on. It ain’t complicated, I promise.”

A barrel-oriented Flashlight with a 1- is installed that can be used without a hand while the weapon is wielded. Runs off easily rechargeable (1 hour) battery packs that last up to 2 hours of continual use. Extra battery packs cost 20eb (Everyday).

This negates the penalty for firing in darkness, night, or low light conditions at targets the flashlight is illuminating (for you and anyone whom can see the flashlight’s projection), but does not negate the penalty from obscurement by smoke, fog, or a similar effect. When the weapon is not currently being wielded, the light automatically turns off.

WEAPON MODS

“V! Your sweet little ‘45 is waitin’ for its mommy! Purrs after every shot now.”

— Robert Wilson

Attachment slots: 0

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Attachment Catalog > Miscellaneous & Accessories).

Unity is often sought after, but difficult to achieve. After all, Night City is a city of individualists, anarchists and warring gangs. To unite under a shared banner, you'll need a persuasive argument – preferably cast from lead. The designers responsible for the Unity understood this well. This universal, inexpensive pistol has resolved countless conflicts and put a stop to disputes. Dissatisfied customers, betrayed spouses, impatient drivers stuck in traffic – chances are they'll pull out a Unity.

Cost: 250eb (Premium)

Slots: 3 • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6).

Special Features: If any damage dealt by this weapon would reduce a target to under 1 HP, they are instead Unconscious at 1 HP. Once per Round when this weapon deals damage past a target’s armor, it also applies the effect of EMP Ammunition, but with a DV13 Cyberteck Check to resist instead of a DV15, and only disabling 1 piece of Cyberware. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, the Cybertech Check is increased to DV15. Whenever this weapon causes a Critical Injury and successfully applies the EMP effect, it disables 2 pieces of Cyberware.
